$comment: Platform and car facts a design for the G20 panel must respect. Copied from shared/visible.js, docs/BAKE-C9-overlays.md and the project's measured limits; each block names its source. Panel px, 1920x720, y down.

geometry.R_units: u = (x - cx) / R, v = (y - cy) / R from the nearer dial centre

platform.source: project measurements on the car and the bench (docs/BAKE-REPORT.md, docs/BAKE-P10-levels.md, commit 7c076df)

shaders.note: Every sampler2D a shader declares must have an asset bound, or the car's renderer (RAMSES) silently does not draw the layer (the bench used to draw it anyway). shared/hud.js binds a 1x1 transparent asset to unused samplers.

source.note: HOOD measured from photo 10 (homography, 108 grid crossings, residual 3.5 px), Nov 11 2026

hood.description: First visible y along each vertical line [x, y]; the hood hides everything above it. Linear between points. Bottom and sides are fully visible.

visible_area.description: The part of the panel the driver sees: below the hood polyline, down to the bottom edge.

bmw_over.description: What BMW draws on top of any custom theme on the panel (observed). A design keeps these areas free of anything important; nothing hides them.

source.note: BLACK_BOX; C9 measured 1419.5, 320.8, 1610.8, 437.9 from photos 10 and 11

BLACK_BOX.what: A solid black rectangle in the middle of the rev dial, only while a custom theme is connected; the stock theme draws its big gear letter there.

source.note: BELT; C9 measured 589.7, 664.9, 623.7, 713.9 from photos 10 and 11

BELT.what: The driver's seat-belt warning lamp (red), drawn over us when lit.

source.note: C9 measured the 'P' at 1398.4, 667.2, 1421.4, 700.2 (photo 10); the rect keeps ~6 px margin because R, N, D, S, M are wider. visible.js no longer carries it (commit cb28ce7 dropped our gear letters and the marker).

GEAR.what: BMW's gear letter (white), drawn over us below the rev dial.
